summary: Batch 5 stealth anti-theft & recovery testing. Updated legacy /setup payload (access/recovery/wipe) and added Batch 5 specific coverage (multi-profile, recovery triggers via phrase/pattern/code, evidence battery, new-device event, bcrypt at rest of profile access_hash + recovery_phrase_hash). All 64 backend tests PASS. Frontend cover->unlock flow (pre-configured dm-cover-test, calculator + 2580=), Setup Wizard 6-step, Lock button, no vault tile, panic/privacy tiles all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: CoverScreen.js uses eval() of user-typed math expression on Calculator '='. Regex sanitises to [0-9+\-*/.] so injection risk is low, but consider Function() or a tiny parser to fully avoid eval lint warnings.

App.js still renders 'tab === 'owner'' and 'tab === 'privacy'' branches but bottom nav only exposes home/recovery/evidence/mate — owner/privacy screens are only reachable from dashboard tiles. Fine, but make sure tiles in SecurityDashboard call onNavigate('owner'|'privacy').
telemetry.deviceId is captured at module load — documented; setup wizard finish auto-unlocks so user does not have to re-enter access code, which is intended.
Old vault references removed (CalculatorVault.js / PhoneDialer.js deleted as expected); no remaining tile-vault testid in dashboard.
test_credentials: Pre-configured device dm-cover-test (access 2580 / recovery rec999 / wipe wipe888 / phrase 'bring it back' / pattern 159 / cover calculator).
seed_data_creation: Each test uses TEST_ prefixed disposable device_ids; events cleaned via DELETE /api/security/events.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend setup payload now requires access_code+recovery_code+wipe_code+recovery_phrase (>=4 chars each, all distinct) and at least one trusted number. /recovery/wipe needs WIPE code + confirm=true; /recovery/unlock + /trap/deactivate + /emergency/verify use RECOVERY code; /verify-access only matches profiles[].access_hash. /profiles/add requires the device recovery code. /recovery/trigger accepts phrase (case-insensitive) | pattern | recovery code. Frontend cover-> dashboard relies on TelemetryService reading dm_device_id at module load — always use addInitScript BEFORE page.goto. Hide #emergent-badge via injected CSS, mobile viewport 390x844, click 'Try the Demo' to leave landing.
rca of the issue: Legacy tests broke because Batch 5 renamed setup payload (recovery_code/vault_code -> access_code/recovery_code/wipe_code/recovery_phrase) and routed /recovery/wipe through _verify_wipe instead of _verify_recovery. Fixed by updating fixtures to send the new payload and pointing wipe assertions at the new WIPE_CODE.
